user.description: Matter Explorer shows every attribute of every Matter device paired to Home Assistant. Nothing needs to be configured.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Matter Explorer is already set up.

matter_not_loaded.title: Matter is not loaded
matter_not_loaded.description: Matter Explorer needs Home Assistant's Matter integration to be loaded and connected to the Matter Server ({reason}). Matter Explorer recovers by itself once the Matter integration is back; if it stays like this, check the Matter integration and the Matter Server add-on.
